Ana (CS): Heads-up — Crestwood Health renewal ~5w. Usage dropped ~64% last 30d, seats 19 -> 6. Champion left. Need quick playbook.

Rowan (CSM): Any errors or billing flags?

Ana (CS): No errors. Procurement mentioned a short eval with MirrorAI. They asked for summarization and embeddings samples.

Tess (RevOps): Billing: embeddings -66%, gen tokens -52%. I can propose a short POC concession.

Ibrahim (Eng): I'll assemble a minimal bake-off harness (500 docs) + deterministic metrics (precision@5, avg cosine gap, 95th pct latency). Will push to /shared/crestwood.

Maya (Support): One ticket: "why cheaper elsewhere?" I asked for their sample dataset.

Rowan (CSM): Proposed actions: (1) 10-day Dedicated-lite trial; (2) bake-off with objective metrics and seeded prompts; (3) retention offer (enablement credit + trial pricing) if we win. I'll schedule kickoff.

Tess (RevOps): Drafting concession: 25% off embeddings during POC + $8k enablement credit on 12mo conversion. Looping in finance.

Ibrahim (Eng): Pushed harness at commit f1a2. Snippet to reproduce:
```
python bench/run.py --data crest_500.json --model rwd-embed-compact --batch 64
```
Link: https://redwood.internal/crestwood/bakeoff

Rowan (CSM): Invite sent for Wed 11am PT. Success metrics: precision@5 >= 0.76, 95th pct latency <= 140ms. Reconvene after bake-off with results and recommended retention play. :white_check_mark:
